title: OpenClaude-Portable belongs on your radar
description:
This repo should be on your radar: techjarves/OpenClaude-Portable. Run Claude Code from a USB drive on any PC — no installation required. It has about 709 GitHub stars, and it is active enough to deserve a closer look. Save this for your next build, and follow for more useful developer tools.

https://github.com/techjarves/OpenClaude-Portable
